newsitem.title: CANADA: Volvo says completes Champion takeover.
newsitem.headline: Volvo says completes Champion takeover.

text.p: AB Volvo unit Volvo Construction Equipment N.V. said on Saturday that about 11,390,050 common shares or 98.8 percent of Champion Road Machinery Ltd had been deposited under a previously announced C$15 a share takeover bid by its Canadian unit.

It said all conditions in the offer, which expired at midnight Toronto time on March 21, had been fulfilled or waived and that it intended to take up the remaining shares under compulsory acquisition procedures.
It said the offer for the Goderich, Ontario-based maker of road-building and road maintenance equipment totalled about C$173 million, equivalent to about 955 million kroner.
